comment: Fixed key-set statement vectors shared by the control plane (TypeScript) and the daemon (tp-host python and openssl). Public data only; regenerate both copies together. Each approval is [id, authenticatorData, clientDataJSON, assertion bytes]; tests turn them into envelopes. keySig, when present, is the replaced key's {pub, sig} over "tp-keyset\n" + the statement bytes.

passkeysLine.comment: The canonical rotation passkey line (the pin file's passkeys= value and what a daemon hashes for its pin report): <id>.<es256|eddsa>.<pub>, comma-joined, sorted by id in code-unit order (so '-' < 'Z' < '_' < 'a'). hash is base64url SHA-256 of line.
